answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing repeated, randomly assigned tasks that require persistent state, with results checked against hidden test cases and cross-validated by independently established agents. A new identity starts with negligible weight, so splitting one attacker’s stake among a thousand accounts does not multiply influence; each account must separately spend time and compute to build a verified record. Even a sonnet about shale lit by an ember earns no credit unless it passes the task checks, making fake identities costly rather than merely numerous.
